intro: Spells of Shadow is a dark grimoire carried by the Searing Blade cultists lurking beneath Orgrimmar in Ragefire Chasm. Filled with fel magic granted by the Burning Legion, it is targeted for recovery by the Forsaken leadership in the Undercity.

p: Hidden deep in the molten caverns of Ragefire Chasm, members of the Searing Blade—a splinter cult tied to the Shadow Council—wield dark rites granted by demon masters of the Burning Legion. Among their most guarded treasures is the Spells of Shadow, a text containing insidious shadow and fel sorcery. Cultists and warlocks of the sect keep this book close at hand as they plot beneath the very feet of the Horde in Durotar.

Word of the Searing Blade's demonic gifts reached the royal quarters of the Undercity. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and her dreadlord lieutenant, Varimathras, determined that such powerful relics were wasted on cultists with lesser vision. Varimathras tasks Horde adventurers with venturing into the chasm to seize the Spells of Shadow alongside its companion tome, Incantations from the Nether, directing their power toward the Forsaken cause against the Scourge and the Lich King.
